JustIn Time Contracting
General Contracting
& Handyman Services

HOME

SERVICES

GALLERY

SERVICES
What do you need?
Remodeling
& Repairs

Everything from a new office in your unfinished basement to fixing loose cabinet handles or replacing out of date smoke alarms, if you need it done I can help.

Furniture assembly or custom build

Got that new piece of furniture that came in a flat box with 1000 steps? Or perhaps you want some custom shelves built?

Something else?

If you have a project, small or large, the roof's the limit. Just ask and I can probably help.

Why replace or service smoke alarms?

​

The simple answer is that they don't have an unlimited life span. The Indiana State Fire Marshal recommends the following to ensure proper function of smoke alarms:

​

1. Test your smoke alarms every month.

2. Replace batteries in your smoke alarms twice a year.

3. Replace smoke alarms every 8-10 years.

cell:  317-349-8265

email: 317JustinTime@gmail.com
